scope: Checker/release acceptance only. No app, CMS, content, production, or immutable candidate export changed.

finding.before: An otherwise valid page with conflicting googlebot noindex,nofollow incorrectly passed177checks. Remote page inspection did not retain X-Robots-Tag.
finding.fixed: Global HTTP and Googlebot/Bingbot scopes plus case-insensitive crawler meta are combined with ordinary robots restrictions. Restrictive rules win; none blocks index and follow. A mixed-case duplicate ordinary robots meta is detected.
finding.falsePositiveControls: Unrelated crawler scopes and max-image-preview:none do not block acceptance. Intentional local CI noindex/follow remains valid.
finding.securityBoundary: Remote production cannot opt into noindex/nofollow expectations. Reads retain manual redirects; no external redirect followed, credential or token added, deployment performed, or new public URL override introduced.

originalCandidateIGates: 13 passed /1257tests in66files before checker-only fix; later focused checks are separately identified, not relabeled as a full original-I rebuild.

ciProductionReview.ci: Local-only nonindexable artifacts use explicit noindex/follow; workflow cannot deploy.
ciProductionReview.publication: Push main only. Checked-outHEAD must equalexpectedGitHubSHA; waits for that exact public release; requires committed content and hard production index/follow; verifies public identity again after all-page parity.
ciProductionReview.releaseIdentity: Cloudflare packaging uses CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA; release.json no-store/noindex headers affect utility only, not public HTML.
ciProductionReview.timeout: Root is adjusting job headroom from30 to45minutes to preserve bounded fail-closed monitoring during delayed build/transport; this review did not edit CI.

remainingBoundaries: Current saved I actual meta/header-rule scan passes, but actual Cloudflare response headers still require post-release capture.
Saved export inspections do not execute server header rules; runtime HTTP headers are evaluated in live parity.
No indexing, ranking, field CWV, browser interaction or deployed release result is implied.
